blockingFindings.title: R6 does not exercise the required end-to-end conflict recovery flow
blockingFindings.target: specs/478-fix-finalize-merge-conflict/tests/finalize-merge-conflict-recovery.test.js test "R6: makes the conflict recovery transaction executable in a Git fixture"
blockingFindings.rationale: R6 explicitly requires shared unit plus worktree CLI/E2E tests to exercise the real recovery sequence. The current spec-local test can pass while the production conflict-detection and retry workflow is broken because it bypasses conflict detection and delegates to unrelated shared tests without asserting this scenario.
blockingFindings.issue: The R6 test uses failMerge(), which directly invokes finalize-merge.onError with a synthetic Error, then only reruns existing shared tests. It does not exercise actual conflict detection, manual rebase, retry, one merge/outbox completion, sync, and cleanup in this spec-local Git fixture.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add executable coverage that drives the real worktree CLI/E2E conflict path: create an actual rebase conflict, verify the evidence commit and clean rebase preparation, perform/continue the manual rebase, retry finalize-merge, and assert one merge/outbox completion plus downstream sync/cleanup behavior.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R6 explicitly requires shared unit plus worktree CLI/E2E tests to exercise the real recovery sequence. blockingFindings.title: R2 does not verify persistence in a final main-side snapshot
blockingFindings.target: specs/478-fix-finalize-merge-conflict/tests/finalize-merge-conflict-recovery.test.js test "R2: records the failed outbox and skipped downstream steps in metadata only"
blockingFindings.rationale: R2's core persistence guarantee is about availability after successful retry in the final main-side snapshot. The current test can pass even if the metadata is lost during actual retry/finalization into main.
blockingFindings.issue: The test reads manager.load() from the same fixture after direct pre/post calls and checks git log/current issue-log contents. It does not perform a successful retry through the final main-repository state or assert that the conflict reason, failed outbox state, skipped downstream states, and issue-log evidence remain present in that final main-side snapshot.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: After a real successful retry/finalization, load the final main-side flow and issue-log snapshot and assert the R2 metadata remains available there.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R2's core persistence guarantee is about availability after successful retry in the final main-side snapshot. The current test can pass even if the metadata is lost during actual retry/finalization into main.

blockingFindings.title: R5 direct finalize/cleanup deleted-worktree behavior is not covered spec-locally
blockingFindings.target: specs/478-fix-finalize-merge-conflict/tests/finalize-merge-conflict-recovery.test.js test "R5: a clean normal merge preparation does not use the conflict recovery commit"
blockingFindings.rationale: Most of R5 has no corresponding spec-local acceptance coverage in this file, despite the coverage artifact marking R5 covered. The current test can pass while the deleted-worktree/main-state completion behavior regresses.
blockingFindings.issue: The R5 test only verifies that clean finalize-merge.pre does not create a new commit, then shells out to broad shared tests. It does not assert that direct finalize/cleanup updates verification and integration records through main-repository flow state after rebase, resumes an interrupted completion from its saved transaction, completes teardown journal/receipt/cleanup through main state, or avoids import/filesystem/lock/log access against a deleted worktree.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add focused assertions or a spec-local harness for the direct finalize/cleanup post-rebase deleted-worktree scenario required by R5, rather than relying only on broad shared test execution.
